snippet.title: Camp Keepalive - Keepalive Mode Gameplay Demo
snippet.description:
Beautiful Camp Keepalive has a bit of a monster problem, but the owners won't let a thing like that keep them down. 

Unfortunately, they also have campers with about as much common sense as toast, and they keep wandering off into the woods at night and getting themselves eaten/dismembered/reduced to puddles of ooze.

That's where you come in: as their latest new hire, you have to guide your fellow counselors in rescuing as many campers as you can from their grisly fates. 

In this quick gameplay video of Keepalive Mode, the player guides a group of four counselors, each with unique abilities, as they head off to the rescue...
